text.p: U.S. financial markets will observe the following hours over the New Year holiday (Tuesday, December 31, and Wednesday, January 1).
U.S. stock markets will be closed on January 1.
The New York Stock Exchange, Nasdaq and the American Stock Exchange will observe normal trading hours on December 31.
U.S. Treasury and related debt markets will close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT December 31 and will remain closed January 1.
Chicago's futures and options exchanges said all markets will be closed January 1.
On December 31, all Chicago Mercantile Exchange contracts except stock indexes will close at 1200 CST/1800 GMT. CME stock indexes will close at their regular times.
The CME's Globex electronic trading will be closed both December 31 and January 1.
All Chicago Board of Trade contracts will close December 31 at 1210 CST/1810 GMT.
Project A afternoon and overnight electronic trading sessions and evening pit trading are closed both December 31 and January 1.
The Chicago Board Options Exchange said its interest rate options will end trade at 1200 CST December 31 but CBOE equity options and index options will close at their regular times.
The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX and COMEX divisions) will be closed January 1. On December 31, the following early closings will be observed:
Metals Markets
copper and palladium 1300 EST/1800 GMT
silver 1305 EST/1805 GMT
gold and platinum 1310 EST/1810 GMT
after-hours electronic ACCESS system will be closed on the evening of December 31 and will reopen at 1900 EST January 1/0000 GMT January 2.
Energy Markets
crude oil, heating oil, gasoline, natural gas and electricity all close at 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
after hours electronic ACCESS system will be closed on the evening of December 31 and will reopen at 1900 EST January 1/0000 GMT January 2.
The New York Coffee, Cocoa and Sugar Exchange (CSCE) will be closed January 1. Early closing of trade on December 31 will be as follows:
cocoa 1200 EST/1700 GMT coffee 1135 EST/1620 GMT sugar 1120 EST/1620 GMT
The New York Cotton Exchange will be closed January 1. For December 31, following is the closing schedule:
cotton 1200 EST/1700 GMT
FCOJ 1200 EST/1700 GMT
CRB usual hours
FINEX 1300 EST/1800 GMT
The Kansas City Board of Trade will be closed on January 1 and will observe the following early closes on December 31:
HRW Wheat Futures Early close at 1210 EST
HRW Wheat Options Early close at 1215 EST
Value Line Futures Regular hours
Value Line Options Regular hours
Mini VL Futures Regular hours
Mini VL Options Regular hours
W Natgas Futures Early close at 1220 EST
W Natgas Options Early close at 1220 EST
Regular trading hours will be observed on all markets on Thursday, January 2.
